market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver currently trades near $30-34/oz; $120 would be a >4x move to an all-time high, far above any historical level. Even with tail events like short squeezes or dollar crises, a 1.5-year window makes this extremely improbable. A 6.6% market price overestimates the true probability, which I estimate near 1%.
evidence_points: Spot silver ~$32 and CME front-month futures similar; ATH ~$50 in 1980 and 2011
Requires >300% gain in ~18 months with no precedent in modern silver market
Settlement-based rule ignores intraday spikes; only daily official prints count, further reducing chance of fleeting spike capture
